provenance.title: Generalised NER outline (display and statistics mask)
provenance.description: Two coarse polygons approximating the North Eastern Region: one for Sikkim (not contiguous with the rest of NER) and one for the remaining seven states, with the Bhutan and Bangladesh borders notched out. Used to mask the hazard grid for display and regional statistics only.
provenance.accuracy: Vertices are placed to roughly 0.15-0.25 deg (15-25 km) and the polygon is deliberately inflated: a few kilometres of adjacent territory may be retained so that no Indian territory is dropped. It is NOT a legal or survey boundary.

polygons.name: Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland and Tripura

notes: The mainland polygon deliberately follows the Bhutan southern border at about 26.8-27.0 N so that Bhutanese territory is not served.
Longitude 89.5 E is the western limit of the mainland part; Sikkim is handled by its own polygon because West Bengal separates it from Assam.
